data.name: windows-11-professional
data.title: Windows 11 Professional
data.description: Microsoft Windows 11 Pro—lifetime retail licence, instant digital delivery.
features: Find My Device, Windows Defender firewall

faq.question: What is the main difference between Windows 11 Home and Pro?
faq.answer: Windows 11 Pro includes all the features of Home, plus additional business and security tools like BitLocker encryption, Remote Desktop, and Hyper-V for virtualization.

faq.question: Is this a lifetime license?
faq.answer: Yes, this is a one-time purchase for a lifetime retail license for one computer. It does not expire.

faq.question: How will I receive the product key?
faq.answer: The product key is delivered instantly to your email address after the purchase is complete.

customerReviews.comment: Key arrived instantly and activation was a breeze. The Pro features like BitLocker are exactly what I needed for my work laptop.
Upgraded from Windows 10 Pro. The process was smooth with this key. Windows 11 feels fresh and modern.
Works perfectly. Hyper-V is essential for my development work. Deducted one star because I had to contact support for the download link, but they responded quickly.

data.name: windows-11-professional-5pc
data.title: Windows 11 Pro – 5 PC
features: All Windows 11 Pro features on 5 devices
Azure AD & local Active Directory join

faq.question: Does this provide 5 separate keys or one key for 5 PCs?
faq.answer: This product provides one license key valid for activation on up to five different computers.

faq.question: Are these licenses suitable for a small business?
faq.answer: Yes, this bundle is ideal for small businesses or studios that need to equip multiple workstations with Windows 11 Professional.

faq.question: Can I use these licenses on PCs in different locations?
faq.answer: Absolutely. As long as the total number of activated machines does not exceed five, you can use them wherever you need.

customerReviews.comment: Perfect for our office setup. Got 5 PCs running on Windows 11 Pro in under an hour. Great value.
Bought this for my family's computers. The multi-pack was much cheaper than buying individual licenses. All activated without issue.

data.title: Windows 11 Home
data.description: Windows 11 Home digital key—fast download & lifetime activation.

faq.question: Do I need a Microsoft Account to install Windows 11 Home?
faq.answer: Yes, a Microsoft Account and an internet connection are required for the initial setup of Windows 11 Home.

faq.question: Can I upgrade from Windows 10 Home with this key?
faq.answer: Yes, you can perform a clean installation or an in-place upgrade from a compatible version of Windows 10 Home.

customerReviews.comment: Got the key in my email right away. Installation on my new PC build was straightforward. Happy with my purchase.
The new interface is great! My laptop feels faster and the Snap Layouts are a game changer for my productivity.
Good price and it works. The requirement for a Microsoft account during setup is a bit annoying, but you can change to a local account later.

data.description: Bundle—activate Windows 11 Home on up to five devices.

faq.question: Is this a good option for a family with multiple computers?
faq.answer: Yes, this 5-PC license bundle is a very cost-effective solution for families, allowing you to install and activate Windows 11 Home on up to five household computers.

customerReviews.comment: Upgraded all our family laptops and the desktop with this pack. One key for all five made it super simple. Excellent value.

data.name: windows-10-professional
data.title: Windows 10 Professional
data.description: Instant Windows 10 Pro OEM key, 1 PC / lifetime.

faq.question: What does an OEM key mean?
faq.answer: An OEM (Original Equipment Manufacturer) key is typically tied to the motherboard of the first PC it's installed on and cannot be transferred to another computer.

faq.question: Can I upgrade to Windows 11 Pro for free with this license?
faq.answer: Yes, if your computer meets the minimum system requirements for Windows 11, this Windows 10 Pro license allows for a free upgrade to Windows 11 Pro.

customerReviews.comment: Needed a stable OS for a business machine that wasn't ready for Win11. This Win10 Pro key was perfect and the price is unbeatable.
Windows 10 is still the king for compatibility with older games. Key worked instantly.

faq.question: Why would I choose Windows 10 Home over Windows 11?
faq.answer: You might prefer Windows 10 Home if your hardware is not compatible with Windows 11, or if you prefer the user interface and stability of Windows 10 for your applications.

customerReviews.comment: Perfect for my older laptop that can't run Windows 11. It's running like new again! Activation was simple.

data.name: windows-10-enterprise
data.title: Windows 10 Enterprise
data.description: Enterprise-grade Windows 10 for medium & large organisations.

faq.question: Is this version suitable for a personal computer?
faq.answer: While it can be installed on a personal PC, Windows 10 Enterprise is designed for IT professionals in medium to large organizations and includes many advanced features a typical home user would not need.

faq.question: What is the main benefit of Enterprise over Pro?
faq.answer: The Enterprise edition offers more advanced security and management features like DirectAccess, AppLocker, and Credential Guard, which are critical for managing large fleets of computers in a corporate environment.

customerReviews.comment: Exactly what we needed for our test environment. DirectAccess and AppLocker work as expected. Legitimate key.

data.name: windows-10-enterprise-ltsc-2021
data.title: Windows 10 Enterprise LTSC 2021
data.description: Long-Term Servicing Channel release—10 years support.
features: System Guard with SMM Firmware Protection

faq.question: What does LTSC mean?
faq.answer: LTSC stands for Long-Term Servicing Channel. This version of Windows receives security updates for 10 years but does not receive the frequent feature updates, making it extremely stable for mission-critical systems.

faq.question: Does LTSC include the Microsoft Store or Cortana?
faq.answer: No, LTSC versions are stripped-down and do not include many consumer-facing apps like the Microsoft Store, Cortana, or Microsoft Edge (though the 2021 version includes Edge).

customerReviews.comment: The only choice for our control systems. We need stability above all, and LTSC 2021 delivers. No bloatware, no surprise updates. It just works.

data.name: windows-8-1-professional
data.title: Windows 8.1 Professional
data.description: Original Windows 8.1 Pro licence, both 32/64-bit ISOs provided.

faq.question: Why would someone buy Windows 8.1 today?
faq.answer: This is primarily for users who need to run legacy software or hardware that is only compatible with Windows 8.1. It is not recommended for general-purpose use as its support period has ended.

faq.question: Does this product still receive security updates?
faq.answer: No, Microsoft ended extended support for Windows 8.1 on January 10, 2023. This operating system will no longer receive security updates.

customerReviews.comment: Had to get a specific machine running for a client with old software. This key worked perfectly for a clean Win 8.1 Pro install. A real lifesaver.
